name: WebKit Engine Dialog Dropdown Element Detachment
description: Native <dialog> element backdrop in WebKit causes option list detachment before click is registered, passing in Chromium but failing in WebKit.

failure_vector.error_log: Error: page.selectOption: Element is not visible or detached in WebKit engine
failure_vector.dom_snapshot: <dialog open class='modal-dialog'><select id='country-select' data-testid='country-picker'><option value='US'>United States</option><option value='VN'>Vietnam</option></select></dialog>
